correctness.rationale: Exact identity \(F=Q^2+qR\) and explicit proper blow-up charts give special double cover of the conic. Conic parametrization proves \(R|_{Q=0}=-(U^8+14U^4V^4+V^8)\); its nonzero discriminant \(2^{40}3^4\) guarantees smooth genus three. Deck action on \(w=Q/s\) is sign change and hyperelliptic involution, hence \(-\mathrm{Id}\) on \(H^1\) for auxiliary odd ℓ. Smooth-proper base change and unramifiedness for good reduction establish inertia order exactly two and minimal ramification index two. Attached independent-running symbolic identity checker passes. Exclusions char two/three and other degeneration parameters are necessary and stated.

value.rationale: The singular \(t=2\) boundary is a natural geometric end of the classical S4 genus-three moduli family, not an arbitrary subfamily. The finding constructs a proper smooth stable model, identifies the exact octahedral hyperelliptic specialization and the ramification-minimal inertia action. That resolves the obstruction to good reduction, a structural invariant important to local moduli geometry; it is more than parameter enumeration or restatement of existing abstract octahedral curve.
